items.title: Pay final electricity settlement invoice
items.quote: Der Rechnungsbetrag ist innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug zur Zahlung fällig.
items.computation: This is a private invoice from a company (Stadtwerke), not a public authority, so the 4-day delivery fiction for authorities does not apply; the period runs from the stated invoice date itself. Start: Rechnungsdatum 14.04.2026 (the day of the triggering event, not counted per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB). Period: 30 days, counted from 15.04.2026 as day 1. April has 16 remaining days from 15.04 to 30.04 (days 1-16), so day 30 falls 14 days into May: 01.05 (day 17) ... 14.05 (day 30). Due date = 14.05.2026, a Thursday, which is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW (payer's Land, § 270 Abs. 4 BGB), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
